ENDORSED BYHenri MartinState Senator 31st District"Peter Lumaj has lived the American Dream. He loves our country and our state, and I am proud to call him a friend. Connecticut is a national embarrassment when it comes to election integrity. The Bridgeport ballot stuffing video went viral, prompting news outlets across the nation to mock the fraud. Yet under one-party rule in Connecticut, Democrats have zero interest in making reforms that will restore public confidence in our elections. The embarrassments and the fraud that have made Connecticut a national punchline will continue until we elect different leaders. As our new Secretary of the State, Peter Lumaj will make those reforms his top priority. He will be a voice for the people of our state who are sick and tired of the seemingly endless voter fraud in Connecticut. I wholeheartedly endorse Peter Lumaj. He will be an excellent Secretary of the State and will work tirelessly to restore trust and integrity in our elections."View all endorsements →
